2609.04183.title: Seeing Before Synthesizing: VLM-Guided Transition Event Discovery for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
2609.04183.paper_summary: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning aims to localize and describe multiple events in untrimmed videos given only an ordered set of event-level captions per video. Recent work synthesizes auxiliary transition captions via LLM to provide additional vision-language alignment, but these captions lack visual grounding and are rigidly assigned to every inter-event gap at a fixed location and duration. To address these, we propose Seeing Before Synthesizing (SBS), a framework that adaptively provides visually grounded linguistic guidance only where warranted. Leveraging a VLM, we generate frame-level narratives for the inter-event gaps and detect transitions from the semantic variation across them. For identified transitions, we then refine inter-event temporal masks by blending the temporal midpoint with the semantic change point and selecting the width that maximizes vision-language alignment. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions and YouCook2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both captioning and localization.
2609.04183.paper_summary_zh: 弱監督密集視頻標題生成旨在根據每個視頻的有序事件級標題集，定位並描述未剪輯視頻中的多個事件。最近的研究通過LLM合成輔助過渡標題，以提供額外的視覺-語言對齊，但這些標題缺乏視覺基礎，並且在固定的位置和持續時間內僵硬地分配給每個事件間隙。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了“先看再合成”（SBS），這是一個框架，根據需要自適應地提供視覺基礎的語言指導。利用VLM，我們為事件間隙生成幀級敘述，並檢測它們之間的語義變化所帶來的過渡。對於已識別的過渡，我們通過將時間中點與語義變化點混合來改進事件間的時間掩碼，並選擇最大化視覺-語言對齊的寬度。在ActivityNet Captions和YouCook2上的實驗顯示，在標題生成和定位方面達到了最先進的性能。
